prompt:
Analyze this CAPA: NC Description: 'Internal audit finding: 8 of 12 sampled employees in production could not explain the quality policy or their contribution to QMS effectiveness. Awareness training records show all employees completed annual refresher, but training content is a 45-minute video with no assessment. Supervisors unable to explain quality objectives relevant to their area.'

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- rootCause (string): identified root cause of the issue
- actions (string): corrective and preventive actions
- evidence (string): evidence required for verification

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response:
{"rootCause":"Ineffective training methodology - the annual refresher uses passive 45-minute video content with no assessment or verification of understanding, failing to ensure employee comprehension of quality policy, their contribution to QMS effectiveness, or role-specific quality objectives. Training completion does not equate to training effectiveness or competency.","actions":"1) Revise training program to include assessment/verification of understanding (quiz, test, or practical demonstration) after video content. 2) Implement interactive training elements to engage employees and reinforce key concepts. 3) Develop role-specific training for supervisors on quality objectives relevant to their area. 4) Conduct competency verification through observations or interviews to confirm understanding. 5) Establish minimum passing score requirement for training completion. 6) Implement periodic spot-checks or refresher assessments throughout the year rather than annual only.","evidence":"1) Updated training materials with embedded assessment component. 2) Training records showing individual assessment scores and pass/fail status. 3) Supervisor training records on quality objectives for their specific area. 4) Re-audit results demonstrating employees can explain quality policy and their contribution to QMS effectiveness. 5) Observation records showing supervisors can articulate relevant quality objectives. 6) Evidence of interactive training elements or practical exercises."}
